release_rule: Ronin Public v1 remains incomplete while any mandatory capability family lacks an end-to-end supported path.

capabilities.summary: Durable Job/Run/Attempt lifecycle, local/container execution, leases, heartbeat, fencing, reclaim, resume, cancellation, evidence and project-scoped HTTP/CLI/SDK foundation.

Workspace/project persistence, project manifests, Git identity, environments and deployment bindings exist; Public v1 API/UI, complete source-control lifecycle and multi-user membership remain incomplete.

Provider-neutral connection/discovery/checkpoint contracts and governed local CSV/JSONL ingestion exist; PostgreSQL/JDBC/object-store/HTTP connector matrix and full incremental execution remain incomplete.
No supported Parquet/Iceberg/Delta table lifecycle and no supported SQL engine path yet.
Notebook execution and pipeline IR foundations exist; notebook/SQL/pipeline CRUD APIs and Web Studio authoring surfaces remain incomplete.

Durable workflow snapshots/task runs, lease-fenced attempts/retries/dependencies, deterministic task-to-Job planning, execution outbox/reconciliation, deployment-aware controller, timezone-aware cron, durable event inbox/delivery, cancellation propagation, timeout enforcement, snapshot-safe bounded backfill generation, shared resource pools and durable leader lease/controller fencing exist; branching/notifications, continuous daemon renewal/full-service leader wrapping, group backfill cancellation, public scheduler APIs/UI and broad operator execution remain incomplete.

Persistent governed asset/revision identity and declared/observed lineage exist; search/glossary/classification, richer traversal, OpenLineage interoperability and complete asset-family integration remain incomplete.
Ontology object/property/link/action schemas and persistence exist; interfaces, object-instance resolution, KG querying/materialization and governed action execution remain incomplete.
No current supported RQL parser/planner/execution/provider path.
Versioned contracts/rules/results and persistence exist; rule execution, scheduler gating, alerts and UI remain incomplete.
Experiment/run/model/evaluation metadata and provenance persistence exist; training, features, MLflow interoperability, inference and serving remain incomplete.
Provider/prompt/vector/RAG/tool/agent contracts and persistence exist; provider execution, indexing, retrieval, evaluation, agent loop, tool execution and token/cost telemetry remain incomplete.
No supported semantic compiler/metrics service/dashboard runtime path.
No supported stream processor, durable offset/window/table-sink path or event-trigger runtime.
Execution evidence and observed container CPU/memory foundations exist; normalized telemetry, alert engine, notification adapters, cost records and budgets remain incomplete.

Typed grants, bearer authorization, transport policy, secret-reference resolver and append-only audit foundations exist; OIDC, users/groups/service identities, role administration, automatic audit instrumentation and production secret backends remain incomplete.

Local/container/Compose foundation exists; provider-neutral store ports have begun. PostgreSQL metadata adapters, shared object storage, Kubernetes/Helm, scheduler HA and backup/restore remain incomplete.
Canonical manifest/migration semantics plus deterministic verified archive IO exist; complete project/asset inventory building and binding-resolution import workflow remain incomplete.
No certified discovery/import/export adapter.
No certified discovery/import/export adapter.
No certified discovery/import/export adapter.
No certified discovery/import/export adapter.
No current web application tree or supported Public v1 Studio journeys.
GitHub Actions remain disabled, main is unprotected, current exact-head automated qualification is absent, and release/security/legal evidence still requires blocked or human-owned work.

human_decisions.summary: Runtime capability namespace, value semantics and ambiguity policy.
Language-neutral runner protocol family and compatibility semantics.
Select and verify a real private vulnerability-reporting route.
License/NOTICE/attribution conclusions and release approval remain human review decisions.

next_critical_path: Keep construction/status docs synchronized with PUBLIC_V1_SCOPE.md.
Complete scheduler broader task adapters, branching/notifications, group backfill cancellation and a continuous leader-renewing daemon that fences cron/event/backfill/controller entrypoints.
Complete semantic Ronin Bundle inventory, binding resolution and transactional import.
Finish storage ports for remaining domains, then add PostgreSQL adapters and an S3-compatible artifact store.
Implement Arrow/Parquet, a reference open lakehouse table profile and a reference SQL engine before broad vendor migration adapters.
Complete remote connectors and safe incremental checkpoint execution.
Expand Public v1 API and start Web Studio against documented/generated APIs.
Implement remaining quality, ontology/KG/RQL, ML, GenAI, semantic, streaming, observability/alerts/FinOps and security runtime paths.
Implement Kubernetes and four certified migration profiles only after their canonical target capabilities execute end to end.
Restore exact-head CI/release qualification only with maintainer authorization and do not claim release readiness before it exists.
